detail: November 24 and 26 marches are described but have no local crowd counts. Their threshold remains pending; arrests, blockades and union strike duration are not substitutes for turnout.
Santiago and Concepción have separate local estimates on Nov12. Other cities are named but local counts are not supplied in opened pages; no national aggregate or missing-city zero is inferred.

These sources document separate dates and phases of health-sector labor action in November; they do not establish that December actions were the same organizers/campaign. No cross-month continuity inferred.
